title: Stainedglass Solo #08
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 20s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long sleek jet-black hair cascading past hips — full body stained glass covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is solid thick glass fused directly to her form, not a garment, made of hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, densely packed edge to edge in an irregular cathedral-window mosaic, never a handful of large sheets, never a single broad panel anywhere on her body, each tiny pane curving to follow her body's true shape with real physical thickness, dark lead-line seams webbing between every one of the hundreds of panes, each seam standing in a small raised ridge casting its own shadow, never flat. BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, no two adjacent panes quite the same shade, bright light passing through each tiny pane individually with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing unbroken onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme high-gloss glass finish, hundreds of small panes visible, never large sheets, never a solid uniform colour block anywhere. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
